# Find existing playlists titled exactly "Spotify R&B Recommendations" (if any)
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
if not spotify_token:
    raise RuntimeError('Missing spotify_token')

matches = []
i = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='Spotify R&B Recommendations', page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', i, 'count', len(page) if isinstance(page, list) else page)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        if pl.get('title') == 'Spotify R&B Recommendations':
            matches.append(pl)
    i += 1

print('exact_matches_count', len(matches))
print('exact_matches', [{'playlist_id':m['playlist_id'],'created_at':m.get('created_at'),'song_ids_len':len(m.get('song_ids',[]))} for m in matches])

recommendations = []

page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('reco_page', page_index, 'size', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    recommendations.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_recommendations', len(recommendations))
# show sample
print('first_5', [(r['song_id'], r.get('title'), r.get('album_title')) for r in recommendations[:5]])
# unique song ids
song_ids = [r['song_id'] for r in recommendations]
print('unique_song_ids', len(set(song_ids)))

# Create new playlist titled exactly "Spotify R&B Recommendations"
if 'spotify_token' not in globals() or not spotify_token:
    raise RuntimeError('Missing spotify_token')

title = 'Spotify R&B Recommendations'
create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=title, access_token=spotify_token)
print('create_res', create_res)
playlist_id = create_res.get('playlist_id')
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Add filtered R&B songs (released this or last year) to the new playlist
song_ids_to_add = [10, 11, 176, 182, 297]
playlist_id = globals().get('playlist_id')
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)
print('song_ids_to_add', song_ids_to_add)

added = []
for sid in song_ids_to_add:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('add', sid, 'res', res)
    added.append(sid)
print('added_count', len(added))

# Verification: confirm playlist songs match intended set
playlist_id = globals().get('playlist_id')
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)
print('playlist_title', pl.get('title'))
print('songs_len', len(pl.get('songs', [])))
print('songs_ids', [s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])])
print('intended_ids', song_ids_to_add)
missing = set(song_ids_to_add) - set([s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])])
extra = set([s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])]) - set(song_ids_to_add)
print('missing', missing)
print('extra', extra)
